metadata.name: Angela Merkel
metadata.description: German chancellor combining a social-market economy, European integration and constitutional federalism with pragmatic social adaptation, managed refugee protection and cautious risk regulation.
metadata.scope: Personal positions and governing conduct during 2005–2021. Coalition measures are attributed cautiously. Modern hypothetical policies are labelled inferred, not claimed as direct statements. Research cutoff 4 October 2026; later views do not overwrite a former governing period.
